title: Zara Larsson’s Broken Heel, Miranda Lambert Cowboy Boots, Snoop Dogg Cookbook & More Can Be Yours at GLAAD’s 2026 Pride Month eBay Auction
summary: The auction kicks off on Tuesday, June 16.
contentText:
Pop star Zara Larsson made headlines on May 8 for her professionalism when her right stiletto heel snapped off mid-performance on live television during the Today show’s Citi Summer Concert Series. She didn’t let it throw her. Instead, she joked with the audience and kept singing and dancing on one foot. Now, you can own that heel, which Larsson has donated to GLAAD’s Pride Month auction.

Other unique items up for auction include a guitar personally signed by Jewel and adorned with custom artwork; a cookbook signed by Snoop Dogg ; and two tickets to the Tony-nominated Broadway hit Titanique , with a post-show cast meet & greet featuring Frankie Grande .

Other artists supporting the auction include Brandi Carlile, Hilary Duff, Jessie Ware, Kacey Musgraves, Miranda Lambert, Pabllo Vittar, Rob Rausch, Sam Smith and Sarah McLachlan.

The auction kicks off on Tuesday, June 16 at 3 p.m. ET on eBay.com/glaad.  All proceeds will benefit GLAAD in support of their mission to accelerate acceptance for the LGBTQ community.

Auction items include:

- Brandi Carlile: 2 tickets to any show. Includes a VIP soundcheck party before the show (except Montauk and All Things Go)

- Evanescence: Front row package (US Only)

- Hilary Duff: 2 tickets for the LA show (July 9); 2 Soundcheck…or Something packages

- Jessie Ware: 2 tickets to her show in LA with a meet & greet on Oct. 20

- Jewel: A guitar personally signed by Jewel and adorned with custom artwork; a signed book; a signed vinyl; a curated merchandise set

- Kacey Musgraves: 2 tickets to LA show; 2 tickets to NY show – both include access to VIP hospitality suite

- La Roux: 2 tickets to either NY or LA + meet & greet

- Melanie Martinez: 2 tickets to any show with a quick meet & greet

- Miranda Lambert: autographed pair of Idyllwind cowboy boots

- Pabllo Vittar: Tour outfits; pair of tickets and a meet & greet to the Lincoln Center show on July 12

- Rob Rausch: autographed pair of personal overalls

- Sam Smith: signed vinyl collection

- Sarah McLachlan: signed vinyl; pair of premium tickets to one of her upcoming 2026 US tour dates.

- Snoop Dogg: signed vinyl; signed cookbook; Death Row chain

- The Pretty Reckless: pair of VIP tickets to any show

- Titanique : 2 tickets with a post-show cast meet & greet featuring Frankie Grande

- Zara Larsson: broken heel from performance on TODAY
